title: AI in Maritime: Revolutionizing Shipping for Sustainability
description: AI is used in maritime shipping for route planning, autonomous vessels, port operations, emissions tracking, and fleet decisions under real-world pressure.
short_description: A clear look at autonomous vessels, route planning, port logistics, emissions tracking, and the rough water beneath the sustainability pitch.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in Maritime for operators, planners, analysts, product teams, and readers tracking mobility systems.
